title: Control-plane stress test
description: Simulate N viewers' and workers' Postgres traffic (viewer updates per segment request, heartbeats, claims, reaps, NOTIFY) with no video against a disposable Postgres, and find where latency climbs.
acceptanceCriteria: A script runs the load at rising N and reports p50/p99 latency per operation and the N where it degrades
The ceiling is stated in streams per Postgres primary in ARCHITECTURE.md
A recommendation on whether NATS JetStream for ephemeral state is worth considering after the MVP
notes: The MVP stays Postgres-only (user decision 2026-11-07). First dogfood metrics reading (2026-11-07): the pgx pool maxes at 4 connections (default for a small pod) shared by every role in one process; size the pool from the load test and make it configurable if the default limits throughput.
